A simple & lightweight module that helps you save all scripts in the game you're currently in, with support for EVERY executor! (that has basic functions)

!! THIS DOES NOT REPLACE SAVEINSTANCE, THE ONLY PURPOSE OF THIS SCRIPT IS TO SAVE OTHER SCRIPTS IN THE GAME WITH BETTER DECOMPILING !!

> This module currently has 3 methods; with them being:
>> getScripts: Returns every script in the game (including in nil instances if supported)
>> saveScripts: Saves every script's bytecode in the game (to bytecodes/Gamename/ScriptName.luac)
>> decompileScripts: Decompiles a list of scripts (and returns the decompiled scripts & how long it took to decompile them), WITH SUPPORT FOR ORACLE!!

Usage:
local module = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bbbbbbbbbbbbbb121/Roblox/refs/heads/main/module.luau"))()

module:decompileScripts(module:getScripts(), "YOUR-ORACLE-KEY")
-- Note that "YOUR-ORACLE-KEY" is optional, if it isn't inputted, the script will use your default executor decompiler.

**THIS SCRIPT IS NOT AFFILIATED WITH ORACLE, WE JUST PROVIDE SUPPORT FOR DECOMPILING WITH ORACLE.**

scripts.title: Noclip Bypass
scripts.script:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local CharacterCollision = ReplicatedStorage.Scripts:FindFirstChild("CharacterCollision")

if CharacterCollision then
    CharacterCollision:Destroy()
    local Head = LocalPlayer.Character.Head
    for _, Connection in getconnections(Head:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanCollide")) do
        Connection:Disable()
    end
    print("Successfully Bypassed Anti-Noclip! By Tomato")
else
    print("Already Bypassed or Failed.")
end
